description:
Hushfeed v0.60.0 targets global TikTok 47.0.3 (`com.zhiliaoapp.musically`).

A small release with three fixes.

* Comments that wouldn't send now go out. TikTok checks each comment against the page you opened most recently, and when that page had already lost its screen, TikTok dropped the comment without a word and left the text in the box. Comment send fix, a new patch that's on by default, checks it against the comment panel instead.
* With Caption above comments on, the caption no longer shows over the video too. Hide the caption still hides it on its own.
* Allow Duet and Stitch now covers creators who limit duets and stitches on their whole account, not just on one video.

## Checked

* 2,040 runtime tests and the patch tests passed, along with both Android lint checks.
* All 94 patches applied to TikTok 47.0.3. Use 47.0.3 when patching.
* On a Galaxy S22 running TikTok 47.0.3, comments from the feed went out. With the state that stopped them forced on, TikTok alone stopped the send at the same point the report showed, and the fix sent it.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer. Refresh the Hushfeed source in Manager to update. Keep the manager's existing signing key.
